Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! West Indies players are out there in the middle and Pakistan openers Mohammad Rizwan and Babar Azam are there in the middle too. The debutant Gudakesh Motie to start for West Indies.
... RUN CHASE …

Shahnawaz Dahani is up for a quick chat. Dahani says that they know West Indies are a very strong batting unit and the plan was to just not let them score freely which could not happen tonight. He mentions that he was ready to come on to bowl whenever the captain needed him and is a little disappointed that he conceded a boundary. He adds that the national team right now has a very good unit and mentions a few names who have been doing well and as far as his selection goes, he mentions that he can only work hard and play with a smile on his face whenever the opportunity comes. Adds that the international arena is definitely different from the domestic arena but they do play at a very high level in domestic cricket as well which always helps.

For a change, West Indies batted first today and made the most of it in the Powerplay as Brandon King, the birthday boy played a good breezy innings. But sadly perished in the last ball of the Powerplay. But Brooks continued the fireworks and then it was the time for the skipper, Nicholas Pooran to unleash his power. His quickfire fifty assured that West Indies cross that 200 mark and with the highest total of this series in their kitty now, it is upto their bowlers now to back it up. Can West Indies defend this huge total or will Pakistan chase this down and hand West Indies a whitewash here? Stay tuned.

The pitch was good to bat on and Pakistan bowlers failed to keep the run rate in control. The two young bowlers for Pakistan Shahnawaz Dahani and Mohammad Wasim eventually got the wicket of two West Indies openers but runs continued to flow. They did not get any wickets after the halfway mark till the 18th over and that allowed Windies batters to bat with freedom. Shahnawaz Dahani was the pick of the bowlers bowling with good pace and control while the other bowlers were smashed all around the park.

So a huge total on the board for West Indies. Pakistan have pulled things back a little in the last few overs but still a very good total on the board. They have got 207 and its upto their bowlers now to defend this out. But Pakistan can still chase this down if they get off to a good start as the pitch is quite flat and looks very good for batting. It will be Pakistan's highest ever chase if they chase this down and we have an interesting second-half of this game coming up.
Brilliant yorker to finish! Right one the money, around middle and leg. Darren Bravo just about manages to get it past the bowler and they get just one run. West Indies end with 207/3!
Full and wide yet again, Powell mistimes the cover drive towards wide long off and picks up yet another single.
Wasim nails the yorker this time, on middle stump. Bravo bunts it back onto the deck as the ball ends up behind the stumps. They scamper through for one.
Full and wide, Rovman Powell creams the cover drive but can't get it past the man at extra cover. Just the single.
Slower in pace yet again but shorter in length, over middle. Bravo pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
A slower ball, very full and on leg stump. Bravo can't get it away on the leg side.
Shahnawaz Dahani finishes his spell off with another trademark yorker. This is tailing into off stump and Bravo does well to jam it out on the off side. They get a single.
Full and on off, Bravo drives it through mid off and this time they do come back for the second as the ball is placed a bit wide off long off. 200 is up for West Indies.
Full and straight, driven down towards long on for a single.

A length ball this time, angled at the pads. Powell looks to flick it on the leg side but gets a top edge as the ball flies over short third man. The fielder chases it down and they get back for the second.
Dahani nails yet another yorker on off stump. Bravo looks to drive it on the off side but gets an inside edge past the stumps and towards short fine leg for one.
Full and straight, Powell drills it towards long on for one.

LEG BYE! Wasim is a lucky boy as he gets away with that one. Another full toss, on the hips. Rovman Powell can't get any bat on it as the ball goes off the pads towards backward square leg. They get a leg bye.
Very full, on off and pushed through covers for a single.
Rovman Powell is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally some respite for Pakistan as Nicholas Pooran is sent packing! Wasim delivers yet another full toss, but this time on middle stump. Nicholas Pooran hangs back and looks to pump this one over the long on fence but doesn't get much timing on this one. The ball goes straight towards Mohammad Nawaz at long on and he makes no mistake with the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nawaz b Mohammad Wasim

Commentary.Commentary: Brilliant piece of fielding! Another wide full toss, Pooran slaps it down towards wide long off. Shadab Khan dives to his right and cuts it off. They get a couple.
SIX! Thumped! Full toss, outside off. Pooran smokes it over the long off fence for another biggie.
NO BALL! Oh my, that could have been nasty! The ball slips out of Wasim's hand and goes right over the stumps. Pooran manages to duck under it in time and a no ball is called. Free Hit to follow.
FOUR! Nicholas Pooran shuffles across and Wasim tries to follow him but ends up serving a full toss. Pooran swings hard at it but gets an outside edge which runs away to the third man fence.
Mohammad Wasim is back into the attack.
Full, around off and worked towards covers for a quick single.

That's fifty for Nicholas Pooran. He's played a captain's knock tonight. Short ball, on off and angled across. Pooran pulls it down in front of square on the leg side and comes back for the second with ease.
Spot on! Dahani hurls across a yorker, on the off pole from 'round the wicket. Bravo manages to jam it out on the off side for a run.

FOUR! Edgy but they all count! This time Dahani just misses the yorker and delivers a low full toss, on off. Darren Bravo opens the face of the bat ever so slightly but the ball goes off the outside edge and races away into the third man fence.

Review! Pakistan have taken a review for LBW! The replays roll in and the UtlraEdge shows that the ball has clearly hit his bat with a huge spike. So Pakistan lose their review and the original decision stays.

NOT OUT! Another yorker, around the off stump and at 146.8 kph. Nicholas Pooran shuffles across the off stump and looks to scoop it over short fine leg. He misses and gets hit on the pads. The bowler seems interested and the review is finally taken. UltraEdge shows that the ball got the bottom edge of the bat before hitting the pads and Pooran survives.
Dahani gets the wide yorker perfect! Pooran looks to jam it out on the off side but gets beaten for pace.
Shahnawaz Dahani is back into the attack now.

FOUR! Banged in short, around middle. Darren Bravo hops a bit to get on top of the bounce and pulls it tennis-style to the left of the deep mid-wicket fielder and picks up a boundary. 16 off the over!
Hasnain gets the yorker in this time. This is just outside the off stump and Pooran squeezes it out to backward point for a run.
SIX! Poor bowling! A slower length ball, around the hips. Nicholas Pooran waits for it and then dispatches it well over the square leg fence.
Full again, on off. Bravo makes a bit of room and drills it down towards long off for another one.
Full and wide, this is driven down towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! A full toss, around the off pole. Nicholas Pooran frees his arms and swats it over mid off and into the fence. West Indies looking to get a big total on the board.
FOUR! Short ball and punished this time! A shorter length delivery and around leg. Darren Bravo gets back and pulls it to backward square leg for a boundary. A much-needed boundary for Darren Bravo.
WIDE! Fuller and wider outside off again. Bravo tries to reach for it but misses. Wide called.
Shorter length, on off. Pooran pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A fuller ball, on off. Bravo hits this hard just over the bowler. Shadab Khan gets a finger on it but the ball doesn't stick and goes behind him for a single.
A fuller ball, on off. Pooran slogs it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Fuller and wider outside off. Pooran tries to reach for it but misses. Wide called.
A fuller ball, on middle. Pooran looks to work it away towards the on side. Gets a leading edge just wide of the bowler.
A flatter ball, outside off. Pooran looks to cut it but misses.
WIDE! Googly and wider outside off. Pooran lets it go.
Fuller on leg. Bravo flicks it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to his right and stops it near the fence. Two runs taken.
A full ball, on middle. Pooran drills it to long on for a single this time.
SIX! A short ball and punished! A slower short ball, around leg. Nicholas Pooran hangs on the back foot and pulls it over backward square leg for a maximum.
A yorker on off. Bravo jams it to square on the off side for a single.
A short ball, on off this time. Darren Bravo looks to pull but misses, Wide called for height.
A full ball, on leg. Clipped to short fine leg.

A length ball, on off. Bravo swings hard across the line. Gets a  thick outside edge towards third man. Haider Ali at the deep there runs across and looks to catch it but ball falls in front of him and the batters take a couple.
Mohammad Hasnain (2-0-19-0) is brought back into the attack.
A full ball, on middle. Bravo hits this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A fuller ball, on off. Pooran looks to reverse sweep it again but misses. The ball hits his pads and loops over Rizwan. A leg bye taken.
A fuller ball, outside off. Driven to long off for a single.
Shorter length, outside off. Pooran cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
WIDE! A googly, outside off. Nicholas Pooran looks to reverse sweep it but misses. Wide called.
Shorter and outside off this time. Pooran reaches for it and gets the bottom of his blade towards the off side.
A shorter length delivery and down the leg side. Bravo looks to pull but misses gets hit on the pads and the batters take a leg bye behind the stumps.
Shadab Khan (2-0-22-0) is back on.
A full ball, on middle. Bravo drills it to long on for a single.
A length ball, on off. Bravo drives it aerially and just short of Babar Azam at mid off.
A short ball, on middle. Bravo pulls it to mid on region. The fielder running behind it misfields a little and the batters take a couple.
A full ball, on leg. Pooran flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A full ball, on off. Pooran drills it straight to mid off this time.
SIX! DISPATCHED! A full toss, on middle. Nicholas Pooran just slams it off his legs over deep square leg for a biggie.
Mohammad Wasim is brought back into the attack.

In the air...but safe! A full ball, around off. Pooran backs away and looks to drive it towards the off side. Gets a thick outside edge and the ball falls just short of the short third man fielder. A single is taken. 15 runs form the over!
A shorter length delivery and around off. Bravo makes room and slaps it to long off for a single.
A flatter ball, around off. Pooran pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
SIX! Another biggie! A full ball, on off. Pooram makes room and slams it over deep extra covers for a biggie.
A full ball, on off. Pooran goes for a reverse-hit but the ball hit his pads. Dot ball.
SIX! Iftikhar Ahmed is greeted with a maximum! A full ball, on off. Nicholas Pooran gets under it as he makes little room and hammers it over long on for a maximum.
Iftikhar Ahmed to have a bowl now.
Lovely delivery! On a length, around the off pole and angling away. This one straightens a bit after pitching and Darren Bravo is beaten past the outside edge as he looks to block.
Into the channel, around off and angling across the batter. Darren Bravo with a stylish leave.

Drinks! So a wicket for Pakistan right at the stroke of the drinks. But is has been a good start for the Windies. They have scored almost 10 runs per over and will be looking to get over 200 tonight from hereon. Pakistan will be hoping that they can chip in with more wickets now and restrict West Indies to a chaseable total. Darren Bravo walks in at number 4.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shamarh Brooks gets dismissed for 49 and Shahnawaz Dahani is absolutely pumped! The plan was clear, to get Brooks pulling and have catchers deep on the leg side and Brooks is caught in the trap. Another well-directed short ball, over middle stump. Brooks sways away from the ball and looks to pull but the ball is onto him a bit quicker. In the end Brooks flat-bats it towards the cow corner fence, where Iftikhar Ahmed takes a fine low catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Iftikhar Ahmed b Shahnawaz Dahani

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length, around leg stump. Pooran pulls it awkwardly towards square leg for a run.
Good-length ball, on top of off and Pooran taps it straight to point.

A well-directed bumper at 144.6 kph. This is around the helmet and brooks looks to take it on. The ball is mistimed aerially but falls well short of the fielder at deep backward square leg. They get a single.
Shahnawaz Dahani is back into the attack now.
On the pads again and flicked away to deep square leg for one. 19 off the over.
Khan comes from 'round the wicket now and bowls a quicker delivery, around the leg stump. Brooks opens the face of the bat and guides it towards short third man.
SIX! Pure timing from Brooks! Tossed up, on a length and around the off pole. Brroks seems to be beaten in flight but he just lunges forward and caresses it over the long off fence for a biggie.
Slightly shorter and around off. Brooks can't get it away on the off side.

SIX! Back-to-back! Shadab Khan tries to compensate for the previous delivery but ends up dragging it down a bit too much. The ball is around the leg stump, Brooks rocks back and pulls it high and handsome over the mid-wicket fence.
SIX! Full and straight. Shamarh Brooks hangs back and hits through the line of the ball. He gets a great connection and the ball sails back over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Just over! Full and wide, Nicholas Pooran hangs back and looks to go over extra cover but gets it off the toe end of the bat. He just manages to clear the fielder and they take two.
There seems to be some problem with the ball. Mohammad Nawaz is warned here for putting saliva on the ball.
Nawaz slows it up a bit and bowls in at the stumps. Pooran looks to slog it away on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the body.
Angled in to middle and leg, Brooks flicks it on the leg side for one.
On the pads, Pooran paddles it fine to short fine leg for a quick single.

In the air...safe! This should have been taken but Brooks gets away with one. Nicely flighted, on middle and this one turns away a bit. Brooks steps down the track and looks to go big against the spin. The ball is skied high towards the mid-wicket region and two fielders, from deep mid-wicket and long on converge but a bit of miscommunication between them leads to the ball falling safely. Single taken.
FOUR! Down the leg side, Shamarh Brooks sweeps it hard and low and finds the backward square leg fence. Cracking shot!
This is pushed a bit wider and Brooks eases it through point for another one.
Shorter in length, around off. Pooran cuts it off the back foot through covers for a run.
This is pushed through a bit quicker and on off stump. Pooran pats it back to the bowler.
A tad short and wide, Brooks rocks back and cuts it through cover-point for a single.
On off and pushed out onto the off side.
Nicely bowled! A touch quicker and flatter, around middle. Brooks looks to defend it out but gets an inside edge back onto the pads.
Nicholas Pooran walks in at number 3 and Shadab Khan is into the attack now.

OUT! Cleaned up! Mohammad Wasim has the last laugh here! Full and quick, on off stump. Brandon King makes a bit of room for himself and tries to play a cheeky shot towards third man. The ball though just sneaks beneath the willow and crashes into off stump. The stump goes flying and King's birthday bash has ended. At the end of the Powerplay, West Indies are 66/1!

SIX! Oh my God! That's on the roof! Wasim bangs it in short but it sits up nicely for the batter. Brandon King hangs back and absolutely nails the pull shot and sends it way over the mid-wicket fence.
Wasim hits the length hard this time and bowls it around off. King looks to pull it away but ends up mistiming it badly. The ball goes uppishly but well short of mid on.
Back of a length, on middle. Brooks stands tall this time and pushes it down the ground for a single.
A full toss now, on leg stump. Brooks eases it through mid-wicket for a couple.

SIX! Not the kind of welcome a bowler expects on his first delivery! A length ball, on the pads. Shamarh Brooks just clips it off his legs and the ball sails over the square leg fence. Lovely piece of timing on that one.
Mohammad Wasim is into the attack now.
Back of a length, around off. King backs away and looks to push at it but misses.So a dot to end the over.
Back of a length, around leg. Brooks tucks it behind square on the on side for a single.
A half-volley on middle. Brooks clips it straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
A full ball, on off and around 149 kph. Brooks drives it to covers off the bottom of his blade.
A full ball, on middle and leg. Brooks clips it to deep square leg and gets a couple.
NO BALL! Full and on middle. Brooks looks to flick it and gets an inside edge onto his pads. There is an appeal but no damage done. Shahnawaz Dahani has overstepped and a Free Hit is coming up now.
A very full ball, outside off. Brooks looks to push at it but misses.
Shahnawaz Dahani comes on to bowl now.
On a length, around off. Brooks steers it to third man for a single. Good over for West Indies again.
A length ball, outside off. King cuts it to point and gets a single this time.
FOUR! A length ball again and punished! A length ball, on off. King cuts it this time through cover-point for another boundary.
FOUR! King is looking in good mood here! A length ball, on off. King makes room and hammers it over mid on for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Brooks punches it to left of point. Shadab Khan there stops it with a dive but a single is taken.
On a length, outside off. Brooks punches it off the back foot towards third man and gets back for two runs.
FOUR! Another bad ball and punished! A short ball, outside off. King stays back in his crease and cuts it hard wide of point for a boundary.
FOUR! A fuller ball, on off. King makes room and drives it uppishly over point this time for a boundary.
SIX! Brandon King gets the first maximum of the game! A full ball, on middle. Kings gets under it and tonks it over long on for a biggie.
Darting on the pads this time. Brooks looks to sweep but gets hit on the pads and takes a leg bye to short fine leg.
FOUR! Short ball and punished! A shorter length delivery on middle. Brooks stays deep in his crease and slaps it wide of mid on for a boundary.
A quicker and fuller ball, on middle. Brooks defend it off the inside half of his blade square on the on side.
FOUR! A boundary to end the over! A length ball, on off. King makes room again and this time slams it wide of mid on for a boundary.
A length ball, around off. King makes room and looks to hit it towards the off side but misses.
A full ball and angling into leg. King looks to flick it but misses. Gets hit on the pads but going down leg.
A good-length delivery and around off. Brooks guides it to third man for a single. He is off the mark.
Back of a length again, on middle. King works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, on off. King defends this off the back foot towards point.
Who will bowl from the other end? It's going to be Mohammad Hasnain.
Full and darted on pads. Clipped to wide of mid on for a single and retains the strike.
Quicker and fuller on off. Pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Another boundary! Shorter length again on middle. King makes room again and hammers it through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! First boundary for Brandon King on his birthday! A Short ball, around off. King backs away and smashes it over covers for a boundary. West Indies and Brandon King are up and running.
A flatter ball, around off. King late cuts it to short third man.
Nawaz tosses it on off. King drives it back to the bowler.

We are ready for play! The umpires are out in the middle and so are the Pakistan players. Shamarh Brooks and Brandon King to open the batting for West Indies. Mohammad Nawaz to start proceedings with the ball. The Windies players take the knee and the hosts have their hands on their hearts to show a united stand against racism.

PITCH REPORT - Bazid Khan is pitchside and he says that the surface is the same one used in the 1st T20I match and looks good for batting. The pace bowlers will have to vary their line and lengths in order to get something out of the wicket.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Nicholas Pooran (C) (WK), Brandon King, Darren Bravo (In for Shai Hope), Shamarh Brooks, Rovman Powell, Odean Smith, Romario Shepherd, Dominic Drakes, Oshane Thomas, Hayden Walsh, Gudakesh Motie (On debut) (In for Akeal Hosein).

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Fakhar Zaman, Haider Ali, Iftikhar Ahmed, Asif Ali, Shadab Khan, Mohammad Nawaz, Mohammad Wasim, Mohammad Hasnain (In for Shaheen Afridi), Shahnawaz Dahani (In for Haris Rauf).
TOSS - Up goes the flip of the coin and it lands in the favour of West Indies. They have elected to BAT first.

Let's talk about the West Indies now. Depleted even before they played a game on this tour. They could have easily cancelled this tour due to the lack of availability of first-choice players, but full credit to them, they are here to fight hard and try and win. They are a young unit and they showed commendable improvement in their performance in the second game. The bowlers came out with a plan and executed it fairly well. The batting too showed better application. Can they take a step further and register a win in the final T20I of this series? Or will Pakistan march ahead and hand West Indies a whitewash here? We shall find out. Stay tuned.

It will be interesting to see whether Pakistan get to chase tonight. There has been dew but not so much as to affect the bowlers. Maybe, that has allowed the fielding side to do better in the second innings.
The Pakistan players are already on the ground and training. They seem to be pumped up. Hard not to be, when you are 2-0 up in a 3-match series. But still, good to see.

Pakistan have been in red-hot form in T20Is this year and they have continued their dominance by registering another series victory and this time, in front of their home crowd. They will be particularly happy with their batting and bowling in the death overs and they look like a well-polished team with every player performing his role to perfection. With the series already in the bag, Babar Azam has already hinted that they will like to test their bench strength. Haider Ali and Mohammad Wasim have already delivered notable contributions in this series and we can expect a few other youngsters from Pakistan to grab their opportunities tonight.

Right then! With the 3rd T20I scheduled to go on as planned, let's talk about cricket. The hosts, Pakistan have already sealed the series with a clinical performance in the first two games of the series and will be hoping to continue their winning run. West Indies, on the other hand, delivered a much-improved performance in the second game and will be eyeing a victory in this final match of the series.
--- MATCH DAY ---

5 pm local (1200 GMT) - This is confirmed. The third T20I is on. Pakistan Cricket Board have tweeted a message on their official account, which has a small video of the players travelling to the ground. Great news!

4.30 pm local (1130 GMT) - Ahem! Some sort of a good news, but still awaiting confirmation. We are hearing that the match is all set to go ahead with players reportedly having left the hotel for the ground. Hurrah for that. But let's also hope that everyone is safe and tested negative.

BREAKING NEWS - Well, not quite the stuff anyone wants to hear. After the early setback due to Covid amongst the West Indian players, forcing to leave out Sheldon Cottrell, Roston Chase and Kyle Mayers, the list now has been populated further. Shai Hope, Akeal Hosein and Justin Greaves have now tested positive ahead of the third T20I, along with the assistant coach and team physician. The last three players have been ruled out effectively of the ODI series as well. What this also does is - put the tour in serious jeopardy. The other members will be tested now, as they would have been in close contact with the latest 5 members. Let's hope for positive news.
